title: Fields in practitioner_accounts.csv
description: One row per project/workflow episode used in the practitioner survey, plus explicitly marked structured-study rows.

columns.account_id: Stable identifier for one project/workflow episode; unique and nonempty.
columns.practitioner_cluster: Stable practitioner-overlap cluster. Distinct accounts sharing a practitioner use the same cluster; this is an overlap component, not a unique-person count.
columns.project_cluster: Stable project cluster. Multiple workflow episodes from one project may share this value.
columns.date: Representative account date, normally the primary-source date.
columns.author: Practitioner(s) represented by the account.
columns.title: Account/project title.
columns.reported_lean_experience: none, novice, learning, some, expert, mixed, or not_reported.
columns.reads_generated_lean: none, selective, substantial, varied, or not_reported.
columns.separate_ai_review: yes/no/unclear: whether a distinct AI review role is explicitly described.
columns.semantic_mismatch: yes/no/qualified/unclear: explicit statement, definition, scope, or correspondence mismatch.
columns.source_defect_found: yes/no/unclear: formalization exposed a defect in the informal mathematical source.
columns.counterexample_used: yes/no/unclear: a counterexample was used to diagnose or communicate a problem.
columns.persistent_project_state: yes/no/unclear: substantive plans, Git records, correspondence documents, or comparable state outside chat.
columns.posthoc_understanding: yes/no/unclear: explicit human mathematical understanding after formal verification.
columns.human_role: Source-grounded short description of reported human activity.
columns.observation: Concise paraphrase of the observation used by the paper.
columns.primary_source_id: source_id of the primary evidence record in practitioner_account_sources.csv.
